newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian UCB soars on Japan hopes, U.S..
newsitem.headline: Belgian UCB soars on Japan hopes, U.S..

text.p: Belgian chemicals and drugs group UCB soared nearly 10 percent on Tuesday on growing investors' enthusiasm for pharmaceutical stocks, strong earnings in the U.S., a solid dollar and potential sales in Japan.
"We think UCB will rise further based firstly on the results in the U.S., and a strong dollar," analyst Jurgen Fryges at KB-Securities told Reuters.
But he said that expectations that UCB's Zyrtec anti-allergy drug would soon get clearance to be sold in Japan had the biggest impact on the share price.
"When this happens we'll see another rally," he said.
At 1035 GMT, UCB was up 4.4 percent at 91,300 francs after earlier touching a new high of 95,000 francs -- up 9.95 percent.
"In the long run there is no reason why UCB will not have the same success in Japan like we've seen in the U.S.," Fryges added.
Analysts said clearance for Zyrtec in Japan, which they said was the world's second-largest pharmaceutical market, could come later this year.
This would enable UCB to start selling Zyrtec from 1998, they said.
